hits.title: The Farmer Companies Raises $17M in Series A Funding
hits.snippet: July 30, 2026 Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Linkedin The Farmer Companies The Farmer Companies , a Burlington, VT-based provider of a cheese snack platform, raised $17M in Series A financing. The round was led by Raff Ventures with participation from AJAX Capital Partners. The company intends to use the funds to expand its national distribution, making strategic acquisitions, and scaling its manufacturing network across North America. Led by CEO Randy Johnson, The Farmer Companies is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) platform and brand builder specializing in cheese-based snacking and licensed food products.
